selected_default: Prefetch disabled (ORG_PREFETCH_RECORDS=0); existing cached individual LMDB reads retained.
implementation: Deduplicate per bounded person window, sort encoded ASCII LMDB keys, fetch with txn.get inside the existing file-long read transaction; retain owned JSON bytes in a byte-bounded overlay. No cursor sequential scan is claimed.
full_run_context: Sequential A/B/A/B; A is the preserved selected Zstd image before prefetch, B is sorted 256-person prefetch. First A starts with fresh isolated Elasticsearch storage; later runs reuse ES. Every run starts a new 2GiB/four-CPU pipeline container, rebuilds the organization store from raw input, and recreates the persons index. Host input caches were warm from profiling; ES/host cache effects are uncontrolled. No heavy profiling or validation ran concurrently. Image builds/ES startup excluded.
microprofile_context: Five sequential fresh constrained containers; all organizations staged; 160000 persons transformed serially without Elasticsearch. Complete output SHA256 identical in every trial. Sample-window read-ahead can bias larger-window timings.

measurement.execution: Full production organization stage; serial bounded person sample; no Elasticsearch.
limitations: Person sample uses the first N rows in every input file, not a random or exhaustive sample.
Person processing is serial; full ingestion uses multiple workers and asynchronous Elasticsearch writes.
Transform timing includes gzip, JSON decoding, join/encoding and SHA256; there is no HTTP or Elasticsearch.
Organization checks verify bounded raw-source bodies and both LMDB reader modes, not every staged value.
Filesystem and host cache state are uncontrolled; compare repeated runs before selecting defaults.
Cgroup peak memory covers the container lifetime; use a fresh container for each invocation.
Prefetch may read/fetch beyond the 20000-person sample cutoff to the end of its window; this does not affect full-ingest timings.

independent_validation.strategy: Independent full raw-source joins of deterministic reservoir samples and missing/unresolved ID examples.
independent_validation.applies_to: Final sorted-prefetch repeat; validation is outside timed ingestion.

repeat_comparison.interpretation: No demonstrated end-to-end gain. Repeated total times nearly equal; prefetch costs more CPU and memory. First control includes fresh-ES warmup, so its slower time does not establish a prefetch speedup.

limitations: Local warm-cache evidence, not a portable maximum or statistically conclusive speed estimate.
Sorted point lookups do not guarantee sequential physical I/O.
The supplied official zero placeholders remain unresolved.
